recap.text: Carl shouts a retreat after an Elle spell freezes a lion-sized Reaver sentry dog carrying a Mini Tactical Nuke, and he lifts the burning block into his inventory before it can explode. He dives atop Donut and triggers the other bombs remotely, and the Reaver castle blows apart from the inside out, wrecking Jamal's legs. Samantha says she will plant her stolen nuke at the college, and Carl keeps his own quiet.

Carl dropped every bomb he carried when he fled Larracos, and now he needs to restock. All he has left are the big ones: Carl's Doomsday Scenario and the tactical nuke still attached to a Reaver sentry dog. The sight of that robot dog reminds him that Samantha has a nuke hidden up her neck hole, and it has to come out as soon as possible.

beats.headline: Into the inventory, frozen
beats.text: Robot sentry dogs pour out of the holes in the Reaver castle's great wall: Reaver Industries Security Sentry Dog, the Ditch Digger, optional anti-personnel explosive. One of the larger ones, the size of a lion, carries a massive glowing bomb notification on its back half, and before Carl can examine it, an Elle spell turns it into a ball of ice. He rushes forward and lifts the block. It burns, but it goes into his inventory before the dog can explode. The bomb says Mini Tactical Nuke. Fall back, he shouts.
beats.gist: Carl lifts an iced sentry dog's glowing bomb into his inventory before it explodes, then shouts fall back.

beats.headline: The castle goes up
beats.text: Carl tells Juice Box to drop the No Disassembles Louis carries and get clear, then runs with the others, shouts for everyone to hit the deck, dives atop Donut and triggers them remotely. The pulse should fry every robot dog at once, but the bombs themselves would still... The Reaver castle explodes from the inside out, flinging them all. Carl's bones break and his hearing goes again, and he decides the bombs are much smaller than he feared: probably only one of the mini nukes went off, maybe two. Everyone seems okay but Jamal, whose legs the initial No Disassemble has wrecked.
beats.gist: Carl sets off the Reaver castle's dog bombs from atop Donut; the blast wrecks Jamal's legs.

beats.headline: Up her neck hole
beats.text: Samantha thinks her child died in the acid, and she is quite certain it is Tish's fault, so once this is done she is going to plant the nuke she stole from Buster, the robot dog she bonded with, up at the college. You have a nuke up your neck hole, Carl asks. He has one too, still attached to one of the dogs, but he is not about to tell her he has one of the dangerous robots. Nobody is nuking anyone, he says. Tell us the plan to save Louis.
beats.gist: Samantha blames Tish for her child's death and wants to nuke the college; Carl says no.

beats.headline: Still in stock
beats.text: Carl dropped every bomb he carried when he fled out of Larracos, and he needs to restock. All he has left are the big bombs, such as Carl's Doomsday Scenario and the tactical nuke still attached to a robot dog. That reminds him that Samantha also has a nuke hidden up her neck hole, and it has to come out as soon as possible.
beats.gist: Carl, low on bombs after fleeing Larracos, remembers that Samantha has a nuke up her neck hole.
